source_snapshot.procedure: Run IB read/write for all CX7 and BF3 for one hour; bandwidth matches SPEC.
source_snapshot.criteria: System remains workable with no unexpected error.
source_snapshot.deepseek: OFED/perftest with unresolved port list and peer.

old_problem: Port/peer mapping, exact perftest roles and project bandwidth SPEC are missing, but the all-CX7/BF3 read/write purpose and one-hour method are clear enough for a parameterized package-gated case.
disposition_reason: ED-03 permits topology/runtime bindings, ED-05 keeps IB distinct from Ethernet, and ED-15 prohibits PASS until the signed numeric SPEC is supplied. Missing ports/peers/thresholds remain execution gates rather than an unresolved review decision.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX row76 all 18 columns, same-row DeepSeek, history3104 and actual next row77/history3105 were read.
Every CX7/BF3 physical IB port requires stable serial/BDF/device/port/GUID/GID/peer identity.
Approved read and write roles, message sizes, concurrency, CPU affinity and one-hour semantics are bound in a run manifest.
No PASS is possible without per-path numeric SPEC, units/statistic/tolerance; no fabric stress ran.

test_case.test_name: All CX7/BF3 InfiniBand read/write stress for one hour
test_case.purpose: Verify every applicable CX7/BF3 IB path sustains approved bidirectional/read-write traffic for one hour at its signed SPEC bandwidth without fabric, link or platform error.
required_package: Pinned read/write role/profile and CPU affinity
Numeric per-path SPEC and abort/recovery plan
test_case.test_command: After topology, package, SPEC and user approval, launch the pinned finite server/client perftest roles for every mapped CX7/BF3 path/direction for the approved one-hour coverage and collect throughput, latency, counters and events.
test_case.expected_result: Every required path meets its signed numeric bandwidth statistic/tolerance for the one-hour scope with stable link/fabric state and no disallowed counter/event increase.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires all mapped ports/directions and signed per-path SPEC. Unresolved `${IB_PORTS}`, read-only coverage, Ethernet counters or an invented threshold cannot pass.
safety_gate: Maintenance window/fabric isolation and peer approval
Finite commands, synchronized clocks and OOB
Abort on link/fabric/error/thermal/heartbeat fault; no auto-retry
test_case.recovery: Stop both endpoints coherently, preserve counters/logs, restore affinity/fabric settings and peer services, quarantine a failing link and do not auto-retry.

source_conflict.reason: Sources align on all-port IB read/write; missing values are explicit project bindings.
